# Defense News

> > Leading source for defense industry news, Pentagon policy analysis, global military operations, and rankings of top defense contractors and influential military leaders.

Defense News provides comprehensive coverage of U.S. Department of Defense decisions, international military affairs, defense technology, and industry developments. The publication features daily briefings, contractor rankings, and in-depth reporting on key geopolitical issues involving Iran, Ukraine, Israel, and other global hotspots.

## Key Topics

- Pentagon and Department of Defense
- Defense contractors (Lockheed Martin, Top 100)
- Global military operations and NATO
- Iran and Middle East conflicts
- Ukraine defense support
- Israel and Tehran relations
- F-35 and defense technology
- Pete Hegseth
- South Korea security
- Drone warfare
- Defense policy and strategy
- Military leadership rankings
- Early Bird Brief newsletter
- Defense industry business

## Pentagon and U.S. Defense Policy

- [Pentagon News: The latest stories and analysis on DoD decisions and policies](https://www.defensenews.com/pentagon/): Pentagon and DoD policy news covering Ukraine, Iran, and defense programs

## Global Military and International Defense

- [Global | Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/): Global defense news covering NATO, F-35, and international military operations

## Daily Briefings and Newsletters

- [Early Bird Brief - Top military, defense and national security headlines. | Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/ebb/): Daily Early Bird Brief newsletter roundup of military and defense news

## Defense Industry Rankings and Analysis

- [Top 100 | Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/top-100/): Annual ranking of top 100 global defense contractors like Lockheed Martin
- [100 Most Influential | Defense News, News about defense programs, business, and technology](https://people.defensenews.com/category.php?category=Marines): 100 Most Influential Marines list featuring military leadership rankings
